summary: Abits Group Inc., a Hong Kong-based crypto-asset finance company listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K (the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US Form 8-K) disclosing the abrupt termination of CEO Conglin Deng on October 6, 2026, without Cause under Section 5(c) of his employment agreement, triggered by a financing-related event approved by a Nominating and Corporate Governance subcommittee. Deng automatically ceased board service; directors Yanyan Sun and Khuat Leok Choong, Lionel also resigned the same day, with no cited disagreements. The board appointed Stephen Faucetta, previously Chief Investment Officer, as CEO and Chairman, plus independent directors Glenn Josephs and Mohsen Khorassani. No deal terms were stated; watch for disclosure on the triggering financing, board-control shift and resulting governance overhang.
